Legal & Compliance

Privacy Policy

Entity: Harion Research (Udyam: UDYAM-MP-22-0035155) · Effective: 29 November 2025

This Privacy Policy explains how Harion Research (a financial education and research platform) collects, uses, stores and protects personal data across our website, the Market Analysis Learning Lab (Research Scanner), and our training programs including the Equity Research Internship Program (60 days, Free to enroll (Certificate ₹500 optional)), under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the Information Technology Act, 2000 and related rules.

  1. Data we collect: Name, email, mobile number, educational background and city; payment references and confirmations (we do not store card, UPI or bank details); IP address, device and usage data via cookies and analytics; application and enrolment responses, report submissions and certificates; and correspondence.
  2. How we collect it: Through enrolment forms, applications, email and direct communication, and automatically through cookies, privacy-friendly analytics and server logs.
  3. Why we use it: To administer the Equity Research Internship Program, Portfolio Manager Program, NISM Series VIII Preparation and workshops, manage enrolments and certificates, process payments, send administrative updates, review submissions, improve the site, keep it secure and meet legal and tax requirements.
  4. Legal basis: Consent, performance of a contract, legal obligation and legitimate interest.
  5. Sharing: On a need-to-know basis with regulated payment gateways, cloud and form providers (such as Google Workspace), email providers, analytics providers and authorities where legally required. All service providers are expected to maintain confidentiality and security.
  6. Storage and transfers: Data may be stored in or outside India, with appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers.
  7. Retention and security: We keep data only as long as needed or required by law, then delete or anonymise it. We use access controls, secure storage and encrypted transmission where applicable.
  8. Your rights: You may request access, correction, withdrawal of consent and deletion, subject to law. Write to our Grievance Officer using the details below.
  9. Cookies: We use cookies for essential functionality and analytics. You can manage them in your browser settings.
  10. Children: Our platforms are not intended for individuals under 18 without parental consent, and we do not knowingly collect data from children under 13.
  11. Updates: Changes take effect when posted on this page.
  12. Grievance Officer: Abhilash Bhoyar, Harion Research. Address: 3rd Floor, Silver Sanchora, R.N.T. Marg, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452001. Email: info@harionresearch.co.in. Phone: +91-7067000393 (Mon–Fri, 9:00–18:00 IST).
